items.t: Balance shaft or timing idler gear wears out
items.job: Replace balance shaft or idler gear, timing chain and related parts
items.note: Owners on MBWorld report shop quotes of $4,000 or more. Mercedes has sometimes helped with cost as goodwill on lower-mileage cars.

items.t: Harsh shifts, limp mode or fluid leak at the transmission plug
items.job: Replace transmission conductor plate and plug adapter, refill fluid
items.note: CarComplaints owners of the 2005 CLK320 reported about $3,000 when the whole transmission needed work.

items.t: Engine stalls or won't restart when hot (crank sensor)

items.job: Replace ignition coils and spark plugs (12 plugs)
items.note: Replacing a single coil costs much less.
One owner paid $86 for a single mount; RepairPal estimates $637 to $850 for the job at a shop.
RepairPal estimates $468 to $1,068 for this job on the CLK430.

items.t: Front control arm and thrust arm bushings crack
items.job: Replace front control arm or thrust arm (with bushings), then align
items.note: RepairPal estimates $321 to $460 for bushings on the CLK320 and $658 to $729 for a control arm on the CLK430.

items.t: Worn tie rod ends and suspension joints
items.job: Replace tie rod ends, then align
items.note: RepairPal estimates $443 to $493 for a tie rod replacement on the CLK430.
RepairPal estimates $457 to $561 at a shop.

items.t: ABS and ESP warning lights from a bad brake light switch
items.note: RepairPal estimates $142 to $199 at a shop.
RepairPal estimates $2,089 to $2,125 at a shop. A rebuilt module costs less.

items.t: Check engine light from secondary air injection faults
items.job: Replace secondary air injection control valve
items.note: RepairPal estimates $127 to $156 for the control solenoid. A failed air pump costs more.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong or fuel pump fails
items.job: Replace fuel pump and fuel level sending unit
items.note: RepairPal estimates $823 to $1,135 for a fuel pump on the CLK320. A sender alone costs less.

items.job: Replace A/C evaporator temperature sensor and recharge
items.note: RepairPal estimates $178 to $207 for the sensor. A leak repair or new compressor costs more.
CarComplaints owners reported an average of about $1,600.

items.t: Fuel pump may keep running after a crash (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Mercedes-Benz dealer (software reprogramming)
items.note: Free under the Mercedes-Benz recall. Check your VIN with a dealer.
